summary: The candidate is mathematically correct and complete. The relative-interior and supporting-plane construction applies to every nonempty centrally symmetric convex base, including a singleton and bases with boundary discontinuities of the root. The reflection permutation, covariance inequality, differential estimate, and final scalar bound are valid for all positive integer dimensions, including empty and singleton integer-site sets and epsilon zero. The actual-body consequence applies the accepted convex-majorant certificate with the same unscaled fiber volumes, sites, centroids, depth, and total mass; it selects the point before the halfspace. The stated constant and its range follow from the supplied estimates on gamma_d and e.
